brief:
Israeli military forces set fire to tents housing displaced Palestinians in the Shajaia neighborhood east of Gaza City, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred as Israeli troops conducted operations in the densely populated area, which has faced repeated military incursions since the start of the conflict.

The Shajaia district has long served as a shelter for displaced residents fleeing fighting in other parts of Gaza. Conditions in makeshift camps have deteriorated sharply, with limited access to food, water, and medical supplies.
title: Israeli troops burn displacement camp tents in Gaza's Shajaia district
